# calltree renders an edge list as an indented tree.
calltree -f graph.txt
cmp stdout want.txt

# A named root restricts the output to that subtree.
calltree -f graph.txt b
stdout '^b\n'
! stdout 'a'

# -depth stops the walk.
calltree -depth=1 -f graph.txt a
cmp stdout want-depth1.txt

-- graph.txt --
a b
b c
c d
-- want.txt --
a
  -> b
    -> c
      -> d
-- want-depth1.txt --
a
  -> b
